attributes.title: SOC 2 CC7 — System Operations | Compliance Dashboard
attributes.visState:
{"title": "SOC 2 CC7 — System Operations | Compliance Dashboard", "type": "markdown", "aggs": [], "params": {"fontSize": 12, "openLinksInNewTab": true, "markdown": "## SOC 2 — CC7: System Operations

**Trust Services Criterion:** The entity monitors system components and detects anomalies, vulnerabilities, and security incidents through continuous monitoring and response activities.

| Sub-Criterion | Audit Focus | Wazuh Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| **CC7.1** | Detection and monitoring of new vulnerabilities | Vulnerability detection module, CVE identification |
| **CC7.2** | Monitoring system components for anomalies indicative of malicious acts or system failures | High-severity alert detection, MITRE ATT&CK technique correlation |
| **CC7.3** | Evaluation of security events to determine if incidents have occurred | Alert severity analysis, threat classification |
| **CC7.4** | Response to identified security incidents | Incident volume trends, rule group distribution |

**Data Source:** Wazuh Vulnerability Detector module and alert rules with level >= 10 (high/critical severity).  
**Default Evidence Period:** Last 90 days (SOC 2 Type 2 examination window)"}}
